title.narrative: European Union Support to Covid-19 Recovery and Resilience of Agriculture and Rural Development in Bosnia and Herzegovina (EU4AGRI-Recovery)

description.narrative: To support Bosnia and Herzegovina in mitigating the economic effects generated by the COVID-19 pandemic. In that light, specifically, it is to mitigate the impact of the COVID-19 crisis on businesses of agri-food and rural (farmers, operators etc.) and ensure business continuity.Technically, through the grants to channel and corresponding business support assistance to beneficiaries (agri-food and rural operators), the Action will target the expected outputs of: 1) Ensured continuation of business activities of agri-food and rural tourism operators affected by the COVID-19 crisis, 2) Improved product and business innovation and reorganization of value chains to maintain functioning, increase competitiveness and strengthen resilience and sustainability of agri-food and rural tourism operators and 3) Supported the development of start-ups in the agri-food sector and rural development.
